summary: This document asks IANA to deprecate three BGP path attributes: DPA, ADVERTISER, and RCID_PATH / CLUSTER_ID. They were associated with an abandoned Internet-Draft and a Historic RFC.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 6938 asks IANA to mark three BGP path attributes as deprecated because their associated specifications were abandoned or Historic. It clarifies that the similarly named CLUSTER_LIST attribute is not affected.

questions: which bgp path attributes did rfc 6938 deprecate
subtitle: IANA deprecates three unused BGP path attribute values.

tldr.problem: The IANA BGP Path Attributes registry included attributes associated with an abandoned Internet-Draft and a Historic RFC.
tldr.mechanism: IANA marks DPA (11), ADVERTISER (12), and RCID_PATH / CLUSTER_ID (13) as deprecated.
tldr.outcome: The RFC explicitly distinguishes CLUSTER_ID from CLUSTER_LIST; CLUSTER_LIST is not deprecated.

today: RFC 6938 is a Proposed Standard. The unit metadata lists no RFC that obsoletes or updates it.

sections.title: Attributes to Deprecate
sections.content: The BGP Path Attributes registry contained DPA, ADVERTISER, and RCID_PATH / CLUSTER_ID. DPA was associated with an Internet-Draft abandoned in 1996; the other attributes were associated with RFC 1863, which RFC 4223 reclassified as Historic. RFC 6938 states that neither specification was in use at the time, nor had they ever been.
sections.plainLanguage: Three registry entries came from work that was abandoned or later classified as Historic. The RFC says neither specification had been used.

sections.title: Registry Changes
sections.content: IANA marked DPA, value 11; ADVERTISER, value 12; and RCID_PATH / CLUSTER_ID, value 13, as deprecated in the BGP Path Attributes registry. The RFC makes clear that this CLUSTER_ID is distinct from CLUSTER_LIST, which is not being deprecated.
sections.plainLanguage: IANA marks values 11, 12, and 13 as deprecated. CLUSTER_LIST is a different attribute and remains outside this change.

sections.title: Security Considerations
sections.content: The RFC says that no meaningful security consequences arise from this registry update. It changes the status of the three named entries in the BGP Path Attributes registry.
sections.plainLanguage: The RFC says the registry update has no meaningful security consequences.
